verdict.rationale: New Relic's docs say you can instrument services with OpenTelemetry for "platform-agnostic observability" and that OTel data integrates with its platform capabilities. That is the core of instrumenting once with open standards and keeping the option to switch backends. The evidence is only two brief first-party statements, with no detail on how ingestion works or how the experience compares to New Relic's proprietary agents. Missing for 10: documented OTLP endpoint and collector setup, feature parity between OTel and native agents, independent or hands-on confirmation of switching backends without re-instrumenting.
